risk: Denial of service of the DOCUMENTATION TOOLCHAIN only. The advisory: `braces` through 3.0.3 has recursive AST walkers with no depth guard, so a deeply nested brace pattern under the character limit exhausts the call stack and terminates the Node.js process with an uncaught RangeError (CVSS 3.1 `AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`: availability only, no confidentiality or integrity impact). To exploit it an attacker has to get such a pattern into a call of `braces`. Here `braces` is installed only in the docs site's npm tree: `npm ls --prefix docs braces` shows one copy, `braces@3.0.3`, under `@docusaurus/core@3.10.2`, through `chokidar@3.6.0` and through `micromatch@4.0.8` of `@docusaurus/utils@3.10.2`. The worst outcome is a Node process of the docs toolchain that stops; nothing is disclosed or altered.
reason: GRANTED BECAUSE THERE IS NO FIXED VERSION TO TAKE. GitHub's advisory names no patched version, and `braces` 3.0.3 is the newest release there is, so an `overrides` floor has nothing to point at; the four other high advisories the `docs-audit` job named on 2026-10-05 had fixed versions and were cleared by three `overrides` entries instead. Time-bounded at 60 days, the precedent of the two `image-size` exceptions, on the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-05 (answer 3 of the maintainer's answers on the next release: overrides for the three fixable advisories and a time-bounded exception for this one, with the maintainer as owner).
mitigation: IN FORCE NOW, each checkable in this tree. (1) NOT SHIPPED: `braces` is a build-time dependency of the documentation site under `docs/`, which is outside the Python distribution; the wheel and the sdist are built from `packages/cdm`, which carries no npm manifest and no npm dependency. (2) NO FRESH RESOLUTION: CI installs the docs toolchain with `npm ci --prefix docs` from the committed `docs/package-lock.json`, so the version audited is the version built. (3) ENFORCED, NOT INTENDED: the `docs-audit` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` fails on any high or critical npm advisory that no file in this directory names, and it derives that allowlist through `gates/codeql_gate.py --emit-pip-audit-ignores`, which drops an expired exception; so on 2026-12-05, the day after `expiry`, the job goes red without anybody editing it, and `tests/test_cdm_security_exceptions.py` fails the whole suite on the same day.
upstream_status: NO FIX EXISTS. The advisory (published 2026-09-18, CVE-2026-93687) lists `braces <= 3.0.3` with no first patched version, and `npm view braces` on 2026-10-05 reads `latest` 3.0.3, published 2024-05-21, with nothing after it. REMOVAL TRIGGER, either of two events: a `braces` release that carries a fix (which falls outside this file's `version_range` of `<=3.0.3`, deliberately, so a fixed release is never covered by this exception), or a `docs/package-lock.json` in which no package depends on `braces`. On either event this file is DELETED and the dependency upgraded at that point rather than at `expiry`, as the two `image-size` exceptions were on 2026-09-16; `expiry` is the backstop for the case where neither event happens.
